6945-HR: description 'Length and the offset to the first hole are specified by the customer' (length-by-customer not stated on page) -> 'The customer specifies the C (offset) dimension; maximum length is 6,000 mm (236.2”)'

Catalog prints inch/mm pairs that do not agree for 6904, 6907, 6905 and 6909 (e.g. 6904 D 5.000” (30.00mm), 6907 F .940” (117.00mm)); values were kept verbatim as printed.
Page 7-118 Mount Bracket to Carriage row for 6905 prints bolt 11-5316 with description 'M6 x 12mm BHSCS' (part-number pattern suggests M5 x 16); kept as printed.
Drawer slide suggested-hardware tables do not say whether the Qty. columns (12/14/16 and 24/28/32) are per slide or per pair.
'Travel Length' in drawer-slide specs comes from the 'Note:' line under each table, not from a table column.
